Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Happening to have an excess of M.S. luggage, I am rather glad to send off an instalment of “the [Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69)” instead of packing it up.

It threatens to be longer than the [Dove](/book/62), and there is a good deal more still to be written, and probably rewritten.
I believe I omitted to say that it would be the most convenient way to me if you could [pay](/topic/160) the £235, the balance of my account to my name at [Messrs Hoare](/organisation/169)’s.

Yours very truly

C M Yonge
